title: What port does the Corvex API listen on by default?

posts.author: firsttimer
posts.body: Following an old tutorial that says hit `localhost:9000` but I get connection refused. Fresh install of the latest Corvex. What's the default port?

posts.author: portwatcher
posts.body: 9000 was the 1.x default. Since 2.0 the default is `8577` (API + dashboard on the same listener, `http.addr: 0.0.0.0:8577`). The tutorial you're reading predates 2.0. Try `curl localhost:8577/healthz`.

posts.author: firsttimer
posts.body: 8577 works. Someone should update that tutorial.
